articles.title: Tokenized Google stock inflated 7,700% in rare DeFi lending exploit
articles.snippet: An attacker inflated the value of a tokenized Google share used as collateral to about 78 times its real price, then borrowed against it, leaving roughly $403,000 in bad debt.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital brings off-exchange settlement to Binance
articles.snippet: The integration addresses one of the biggest obstacles keeping institutional capital on the sidelines of crypto markets: exchange counterparty risk.

articles.title: BitMine, Sharplink and Joe Lubin Accelerate Wall Street Ethereum Push With Nonprofit Launch
articles.snippet: Ethereum Institutional will serve as a point of contact for financial institutions seeking to get more involved with on-chain infrastructure.
